things.name: the Mithraic Altar
things.who: designed by Thomas Wright for Jemima, Marchioness Grey, and her husband Philip Yorke; its Greek inscription was written by Daniel Wray

things.name: the Hutton Monument
things.who: put up by Henry Grey, Duke of Kent, in memory of his friend Thomas Hutton

things.name: the Athenian Letters
things.who: written by a circle of friends around Philip Yorke and his brother Charles, including Daniel Wray, as letters from a Persian agent in Athens

things.name: Thomas Wright's Original Theory of the Universe
things.who: self-published by Thomas Wright of Durham in a very small printing

things.name: Immanuel Kant's Universal Natural History and Theory of the Heavens
things.who: published anonymously by Immanuel Kant, who had read a review of Thomas Wright's book

things.name: the Chinese Temple
things.who: built for Jemima, Marchioness Grey, possibly to designs by William Chambers; Edward Stevens repaired it in 1769 and it was rebuilt or remodelled for Anne Florence, Countess Cowper, in 1876

things.name: the Chinese Bridge
things.who: designed by Anne Florence, Countess Cowper, and built by estate workmen, replacing a timber bridge of the 1760s

things.name: the Great Pagoda at Kew
things.who: designed by William Chambers for Princess Augusta

things.name: Chambers's Designs of Chinese Buildings
things.who: published in London by William Chambers

things.name: the lead statue of Diana and the greyhound
things.who: thought to be by Andrew Carpenter, bought for Henry Grey, Duke of Kent; sold away with Wrest in 1917 and bought back with Art Fund help in 2012

things.name: the five ancient altars
things.who: bought by Amabel, Countess de Grey, from T. Beauclere of Muswell Hill

things.name: the carving of the five ancient altars
things.who: carved in Greek lands in the late Hellenistic period, the late second to first century BC; the maker is unknown

things.name: the Atlas statue
things.who: a Portland stone figure of the early eighteenth century, probably one of Henry Grey, Duke of Kent's garden additions; the sculptor is unknown

people.name: Thomas Wright of Durham
people.who: the Durham clockmaker, astronomer and garden designer credited with the Mithraic Altar; tutor to Jemima, and author of the 1750 Original Theory of the Universe
events: was apprenticed to a clockmaker at Bishop Auckland
opened a navigation school in Sunderland
published his engraved diagram of the heavens, Clavis coelestis
published An Original Theory or New Hypothesis of the Universe
bought and rebuilt the house in which he was born

people.name: Sir William Chambers
people.who: the architect who had been to China three times and built the Great Pagoda at Kew; possibly the designer of the Chinese Temple
events: began working for the Swedish East India Company, making three voyages to China (to 1749)
published Designs of Chinese Buildings
began the Great Pagoda at Kew (finished 1762)

people.name: Anne Florence, Countess Cowper
people.who: the daughter of Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey, who inherited Wrest in 1859 and designed the Chinese Bridge
events: inherited Wrest
designed the Chinese Bridge, built of brick by estate workmen

people.name: Amabel, Countess de Grey
people.who: Jemima's daughter, made Countess de Grey in 1816, who left Wrest to her nephew Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey
events: inherited Wrest when her mother Jemima died
was made Countess de Grey
bought the five ancient altars
died, leaving Wrest to her nephew Thomas

people.name: Jemima, Marchioness Grey
people.who: the granddaughter and heir of Henry Grey, Duke of Kent; wife of Philip Yorke, who became 2nd Earl of Hardwicke in 1764
events: inherited Wrest when her grandfather died
married Philip Yorke
had the Mithraic Altar put up with her husband and friends
brought in Capability Brown to soften the garden (work to 1760)
had the Chinese Temple built, about this date
had the Bath House built (to 1771)
